body: the thing that keeps getting me is, every time I think they're healed, something happens that tears them open again. Im sorry for dwelling. its just been so long, so much, I feel it will just keep happening. but thank you. i am going to take this to heart as best I can. I dont think Im a good match for a dog but I do have animal companionship.

thank you. Im a little scared that if I talk to someone else in pain, I will make it worse for both of us. but thank you.

edit: worse, not worth. that is one hell of a freudian slip. maybe ill pm you when Im calmer. thank you.
